argument: What feasible image-derived methods can recover chord symbols and their timing from low-resolution single-staff church music excerpts while preserving an existing melody transcription, and what are their limitations for editable kern and transposition?
why: Data and baseline inspection are complete. The enlarged baseline has substantially fewer melody errors than alternatives but misses 30 of 38 pilot chords. A source-informed chord recovery experiment could isolate this failure without requiring unavailable Audiveris installation.
hypothesis: Recovering chord text separately from staff notation can reduce missing chord labels while preserving the strongest available melody baseline.
expected_observation: Sources identify feasible recognition and alignment methods, supported chord representations, and limitations that enable a small discriminating experiment.
